title: Shopping cart for guests

sourcesRead.contributes: description (guests, cart kept across page views, anonymous carts), the criteria table AC-1 to AC-8, test data

context: Guests (not signed in) can collect products in a cart before checkout. The web shop keeps the cart across page views; the cart API is also used by the mobile app.

gaps.element: conflicting criteria for deleting a cart that was already deleted: AC-7 (L27) says it responds 204, AC-8 (L28) says any request for a cart that does not exist responds 404 with the message "Cart not found"

tried.result: L27 and L28 give different answers for the same request; neither says it supersedes the other

gaps.value: The specific criterion is an exception to the general one: deleting a cart that was already deleted responds 204 (AC-7); every other request for a cart that does not exist responds 404 with "Cart not found" (AC-8). Reason: AC-7 names this case explicitly and calls deletion idempotent, which a 404 on the second delete would contradict.

gaps.value: the sum of the quantities of all products in the cart (a quantity chosen on the product page adds that many items)

gaps.element: what the cart total on the cart page must equal: the sum of the line totals, or that plus other charges

tried.result: L25 says the page shows "the cart total" without saying how it is made up

gaps.value: the cart total is the sum of the line totals of the products listed
